title: Sorcerer in the Violet Marsh
description: A hooded figure in a flowing purple robe stands with their back to the viewer at the edge of a dark marsh. In one hand they hold a glowing lantern, while the other raises a staff topped with a burning, smoky flame. The ground is covered in purple flowers and stones, with broken stone ruins to the left and twisted dark trees to the right under a stormy sky.
prompt: A lone hooded sorcerer wearing an ornate deep purple robe stands with back to viewer at the edge of a dark misty marsh at night. He holds a glowing lantern in one hand and raises a staff with a burning fiery tip that emits thick smoke in the other. The ground is covered with purple wildflowers and round stones, broken stone ruins on the left, twisted dark trees on the right, heavy storm clouds and purple mist fill the atmosphere, dramatic cinematic lighting, dark fantasy style
